question: Compare how long the Matrice 30T and the Matrice 210 V1 wait after signal loss before starting Failsafe RTH.

intake.focus: loss of control link and failsafe RTH timing
intake.reason: Question asks for guidance/manuals on signal loss and behavior (RTH timing) for Matrice 30T and Matrice 210 V1.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance states to try to reestablish the control link and to start emergency or contingency procedures if control link is lost; it also requires that the preflight brief include control link loss procedures and allows discontinuing flight until inspection. No usable evidence from manuals for Matrice 30T or Matrice 210 V1 timing after signal loss is provided. No usable evidence from incident reports is provided (unverified accounts exist elsewhere but not in these records). The main gap: there is no explicit time delay or automatic Failsafe RTH timing after loss of signal in the claims reviewed.

claims.text: FAA AC 107-2A states: "Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft"; if connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft

claims.text: FAA AC 107-2A states: "The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures."
claims.quote: The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures.

claims.text: FAA AC 107-2A states: "Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft."
claims.quote: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
